correct_completion: I would have applied for the job last year.
full_sentence: If I were more confident, I would have applied for the job last year.
acceptable_variants: I would have taken the chance.
I would have spoken to my manager.

options.text: I will apply for the job tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This is a future plan. It does not show a past result of a present condition.

options.text: I would have applied for the job last year.
I applied for the job yesterday.
options.why_wrong: This is a simple past fact and does not express a hypothetical result.

options.text: I have been confident for years.
options.why_wrong: This states a present fact and does not fit the structure after 'if I were'.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: present condition with a past result
explanation: Mixed conditionals connect a present hypothetical condition with a past result. Use the past simple (were) in the if-clause and would have plus past participle in the main clause, with last year to mark the past.
translation: Gdybym był bardziej pewny siebie, zgłosiłbym się na to stanowisko w zeszłym roku.
